arguments.sql_query: SELECT TOP 20 * FROM omop.concept_numeric WHERE concept_id IN (3006923,3005755,3027388,46235106,46236949)

WITH alt AS (SELECT TOP 1000 range_high FROM omop.measurement WHERE measurement_concept_id IN (3006923,3005755,3027388,46235106,46236949) AND value_as_number IS NOT NULL) SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN range_high IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_range_high, MIN(range_high) AS min_range_high, MAX(range_high) AS max_range_high FROM alt

WITH mtx_desc AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS drug_concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 1305058
), mtx_exposures AS (
  SELECT de.person_id, de.drug_exposure_start_date
  FROM omop.drug_exposure de
  JOIN mtx_desc d ON de.drug_concept_id = d.drug_concept_id
  WHERE de.drug_exposure_start_date IS NOT NULL
), new_users AS (
  SELECT person_id, MIN(drug_exposure_start_date) AS index_date
  FROM mtx_exposures
  GROUP BY person_id
), alt_concepts AS (
  SELECT concept_id AS measurement_concept_id
  FROM omop.concept
  WHERE concept_id IN (3005755,3006923,3027388,46235106,46236949)
), flags AS (
  SELECT nu.person_id, nu.index_date,
         MAX(CASE WHEN m.measurement_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_alt_60d,
         MAX(CASE WHEN m.value_as_number > 2 * CASE WHEN m.range_high IS NOT NULL AND m.range_high > 0 THEN m.range_high ELSE 40 END THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS alt_gt_2x_uln_60d
  FROM new_users nu
  LEFT JOIN omop.measurement m
    ON m.person_id = nu.person_id
   AND m.measurement_concept_id IN (SELECT measurement_concept_id FROM alt_concepts)
   AND m.value_as_number IS NOT NULL
   AND m.measurement_date >= nu.index_date
   AND m.measurement_date < DATEADD(day, 61, nu.index_date)
  GROUP BY nu.person_id, nu.index_date
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_mtx_users,
       SUM(has_alt_60d) AS with_alt_measured_60d,
       SUM(alt_gt_2x_uln_60d) AS users_alt_gt_2x_uln_60d,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(alt_gt_2x_uln_60d) / NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS pct_of_all_new_users,
       CAST(100.0 * SUM(alt_gt_2x_uln_60d) / NULLIF(SUM(has_alt_60d),0) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS pct_among_measured
FROM flags;

content.text:
Among new methotrexate users:

- New users identified: 12,693
- Had ALT measured within 60 days: 6,696
- ALT > 2× ULN within 60 days: 1,395

Proportion:
- 10.99% of all new methotrexate users
- 20.83% among those with ALT measured within 60 days

I used ALT lab concepts for alanine aminotransferase and treated ULN as the recorded `range_high` when present; because `range_high` was mostly missing/zero in this dataset, I used 40 IU/L as the fallback ULN.
